requirement: Soft delete a clinical metric inside one transaction: stamp IsDeleted/DeletedAt on the metric and cascade the soft delete to every rule of that metric only, and report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live clinical metric exists for the target id
The target metric owns the scoring or major/minor rules seeded for the case
Another live metric with its own rules exists
The target id matches no live metric

inputs.text: Delete a metric that has no rule
Delete a metric holding five scoring rules
Delete a metric holding two major/minor rules
Delete one of two metrics whose rules reference the same criteria
Delete the middle one of three metrics
Delete request with an unknown id
Second delete request for an already deleted metric
Delete request for a metric that was soft deleted beforehand

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the metric keeps its payload and gains a deletion timestamp
Every rule of the deleted metric is soft deleted in the same transaction
Other metrics, their rules, and the shared criteria stay untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Clinical metric not found' error
A rejected delete never moves an existing deletion timestamp

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or already-deleted metric is returned as a failed Result
